why.en: Oil and coal are finite and cannot be replenished naturally, which makes them non-renewable.
why.bn: Oil আর coal finite, প্রাকৃতিকভাবে replenish হয় না — তাই এগুলো non-renewable।

why.en: "Polluted" is the adjective form, describing the state of the river after "become".
why.bn: "Polluted" হলো adjective form, "become"-এর পরে নদীর অবস্থা বর্ণনা করছে।

q.en: "Wildlife ___ efforts have helped several species recover."
q.bn: "Wildlife ___ efforts have helped several species recover."

why.en: "Wildlife conservation efforts" is the fixed collocation, using the noun form "conservation".
why.bn: "Wildlife conservation efforts" fixed collocation, noun form "conservation" ব্যবহার করে।

q.en: In the standard cause-and-effect chain, which comes first?
q.bn: Standard cause-and-effect chain-এ কোনটা প্রথমে আসে?

why.en: The chain runs: burning fossil fuels → greenhouse gas emissions → global warming → rising sea levels / extreme weather.
why.bn: Chain-টা চলে এভাবে: burning fossil fuels → greenhouse gas emissions → global warming → rising sea levels / extreme weather।

q.en: What's the difference between "climate change" and "climate crisis"?

options.en: "Climate crisis" is the neutral term; "climate change" signals urgency.
options.bn: "Climate crisis" neutral term; "climate change" urgency বোঝায়।

options.en: "Climate change" is the neutral/technical term; "climate crisis" signals urgency.
options.bn: "Climate change" neutral/technical term; "climate crisis" urgency বোঝায়।

why.en: "Climate change" is the standard, neutral term; "climate crisis" is used to emphasise urgency and severity.
why.bn: "Climate change" standard, neutral term; "climate crisis" urgency ও severity emphasize করতে ব্যবহার হয়।
